description: Review policy DoFlow ships. The analyzer resolves three tiers, lowest precedence first: its built-in literal, this file, then agent-docs/review-policy.json in the repository under review. A project overrides individual values by declaring only those values in its own file; everything it omits resolves from here. Documentation must name this file rather than restate any value in it, and a guard in the default test suite fails when a shipped document carries a number declared here.
